methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.scenario: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley
signals.signal_reading: A city-led initiative to evaluate AI applications signals potential for distributed capability-building outside traditional tech hubs, but success depends on whether evaluation translates into deep implementation or remains at the shallow adoption layer.

signals.title: AI is already common in Virginia Beach high schools. Leaders weigh guardrails - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: AI already embedded in Virginia Beach high schools with leaders now seeking guardrails indicates broad but platform-driven adoption—students are users, not builders, suggesting shallow distribution rather than deep technical fluency development.

signals.title: UVA President Scott Beardsley charts University’s future in artificial intelligence - UVA Today
signals.signal_reading: UVA presidential focus on AI strategy concentrates research capability and talent development in an established academic hub, likely reinforcing metro advantage unless explicit distributed education and partnership mechanisms reach underserved regions.

signals.title: ODU, CHKD want to map hotspots of childhood asthma in Hampton Roads with AI - WHRO
signals.signal_reading: ODU-CHKD collaboration using AI for pediatric health mapping demonstrates deep technical application emerging in Hampton Roads medical-academic corridor, expanding Virginia's excellence geography beyond NoVA but still concentrated in metro institutional partnerships.

signals.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia — site to be repurposed for mixed-use and residential development. - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Amazon canceling data centers due to local backlash reveals infrastructure resistance in Virginia's leading AI region, potentially constraining the physical layer needed for both concentrated excellence and future distribution—a signal of stalled buildout across all scenarios.
